loginTitle: Understand the slowdown. Keep control of the fix.
loginIntro: A read-only workspace for Query Store, blocking and deadlock evidence. No automatic tuning. No raw SQL retained.
keyHelp: Use the access key configured on your server. Database credentials never enter this browser.
noPublicData: Every API requires authentication, including the synthetic replay.
noActions: No KILL. No index changes. No plan forcing.
footer: Signals for investigation. Decisions remain with your DBA.
overviewIntro: Separate a real signal from an incomplete observation.
queriesIntro: Compare weighted runtime statistics and the plans behind them.
blockingIntro: Point-in-time waits, direct blockers and incomplete-chain boundaries.
deadlocksIntro: Sanitized Extended Events evidence. No SQL text, logins or host names.
methodIntro: What these numbers mean, how they were collected, and where they stop.
liveBanner: LIVE / READ-ONLY COLLECTION / No automatic remediation. Inspect source freshness below.
replayBanner: SYNTHETIC REPLAY / NO DATABASE CONNECTED / Illustrative evidence, not measured performance.
candidateDisclaimer: An investigation signal, not a verdict
pointInTime: Point-in-time sample, not an incident total
retainedEvents: Bounded XEL history; gaps are possible
priorityDescription: Ranked by estimated additional elapsed time
notCausation: A changed plan and a slower mean can coincide without proving causation. Compare parameters, load, waits and capture coverage before taking action.
coverageIntro: Each source has its own observation time
privacyText: Raw SQL, parameter values, login names and host names are not stored. IDs and aggregate counters remain available for investigation.
windowComparisonIntro: Means in milliseconds; not a percentile chart
queryInventoryIntro: Successful executions, closed intervals, no cross-snapshot summation
noQueries: No qualifying closed intervals. Check capture state, interval length and source status.
planDetailsIntro: Plan IDs, hashes and per-interval counters. Raw Showplan XML and statement text are deliberately omitted.
blockingLimit: Polling can miss short waits. A sleeping session can block others. Negative owner IDs are not killable session IDs. No automatic intervention.
noBlocking: No blocked request observed in this successful sample.
sourceUnavailable: Source unavailable or disabled. Missing observations are not a clean bill of health.
deadlockNotice: Events are deduplicated within retained files and local history. File rollover, downtime and server-wide row caps can leave gaps.
noDeadlocks: No matching event in the retained observation window.
weightedTitle: Weighted arithmetic, not average of averages
weightedText: Sum mean duration times execution count, then divide by total executions. Convert source microseconds to milliseconds exactly once.
windowsText: The latest closed Query Store interval anchors the comparison. Boundary-crossing intervals are excluded, not prorated. Small samples and truncated reads suppress regression classification.
planTitle: Plan correlation is not causal proof
noTuningText: No arbitrary SQL endpoint, index action, plan forcing or session termination. Schema-changing demo operations live only in the separately guarded lab tool.
scopeText: SQL Server 2019+ targets; SQL Server 2022 is the lab target. One collector process with bounded local JSON persistence. No HA, enterprise SSO or Azure SQL qualification.
waitingForTarget: Waiting for the first collector sample.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed; displayed data may be stale
tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait one minute.
loginFailed: Sign-in failed. Check the access key and configured public origin.
logoutFailed: Sign-out failed. Do not assume the session is closed.
serverUnavailable: Server not ready. Check its console.
